questions.q1: 整体形态是什么？报告全层分数、最高层、近优层、极差和描述性形态。
questions.q2: 差异有多大、证据有多强？比较开发均值最高层与预设最后层，报告受试者配对差异。
questions.q3: 群体选层是否代表各受试者？报告个人最高/近优层、群体层距个人最高分的差距，以及逐一移除受试者后的选层敏感性。
questions.q4: 选层结论能否在未参与选择的新材料上复现？固定层后比较其相对最后层的优势是否保持，并报告距确认材料最高观测分数的差距；无确认材料须回答未评价。

aggregation: mean stimulus blocks within each subject; then equal-weight mean subjects
baseline_rule: baseline_layer must be the last layer in the declared layer order
tie_break: first in declared layer order for q2/q3 comparisons

shape_rules.single_peak: nonflat; exactly one layer within margin of maximum
shape_rules.plateau: nonflat; multiple contiguous layers within margin of maximum
shape_rules.multiple_high_regions: nonflat; near-top layers are not contiguous

difference_rules.mixed: some subject differences < -margin and some > margin

subject_consistency_rules.subject_gap_to_best: each subject's highest layer mean minus that subject's score for the group-selected layer
subject_consistency_rules.representativeness: broadly_representative iff group-selected layer is within margin of the personal maximum for >=75% of observed subjects; otherwise heterogeneous
subject_consistency_rules.leave_one_subject_out: omit each subject in turn, re-average remaining subjects equally, and report highest/near-top layers and original selected-layer gap; no model refitting
subject_consistency_rules.influential_subjects: omitted subjects for which the original selected-layer gap exceeds margin + 1e-12; exact winner flips within a plateau do not qualify
subject_consistency_rules.leave_one_out_sensitive: true iff influential_subjects is nonempty; false only means no single-subject removal exceeded the threshold, not absence of multi-subject influence
subject_consistency_rules.scope: observed_subjects only; removal sensitivity is not held-out-subject generalization

material_replication_rules.design: same subjects, model layers and measurement protocol; disjoint development/confirmation stimulus-block IDs; freeze selection before confirmation
material_replication_rules.difference: frozen layer minus the predeclared baseline, on development and confirmation separately

advantage_conclusion.not_evaluated: confirmation unavailable; all confirmation measurements are null
advantage_conclusion.no_development_advantage: confirmation exists but development difference <= margin + 1e-12; do not claim an advantage was retained
advantage_conclusion.advantage_retained: development difference > margin + 1e-12 and confirmation difference > margin + 1e-12; does not imply equal effect size
advantage_conclusion.advantage_reversed: development difference > margin + 1e-12 and confirmation difference < -margin - 1e-12
advantage_conclusion.advantage_not_retained: development difference > margin + 1e-12 and neither retention nor reversal rule holds; not proof of equivalence

material_replication_rules.near_optimality: independently report retained_near_optimal iff frozen layer is within margin + 1e-12 of the confirmation observed maximum; otherwise not_retained; not_evaluated without confirmation
material_replication_rules.scope: same_subjects_new_material when evaluated, otherwise not_evaluated; not a claim about OOD or unseen subjects

shift_rule: only new_material with confirmation, otherwise none; subject sets must match and block sets must be disjoint
inference: descriptive_only; no confidence intervals, p-values, equivalence tests, or biological inference
scoring: all four verified answers => profile_analysis_success=1; four_question_score is the fraction passing
free_prose: retained for human review; not automatically evaluated
